claim: Original Fire Pro Wrestling World Unity 5.6.5p3 globalgamemanagers BuildSettings ClassID141 PathID11 has an exact 55,660-byte source body SHA256 003559802f791e7293ffbc71e830d5aef20e7882fe5e45de8fdf2db034d39a6f. Original full structured parse ends in a two-element m_GraphicsAPIs integer vector with exact values [2,1] in that order, at absolute file offset 0x1DF40, finishing exactly at the declared object boundary 0x1DF4C. Unity's published GraphicsDeviceType numeric enum identifies 2 as Direct3D11 and 1 as Direct3D9, so the retail build encodes Direct3D11 followed by Direct3D9 as candidates. This is a build-source ordering fact only and is not a claim that either device was active in a specific game session.
